crossRefs.note: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear Yahweh all day long.
God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.
David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue; for…
You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for…
Blessed be Yahweh, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify Yahweh’s…
For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because…
So we fasted and begged our God for this: and he granted our request.
Lord, I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants, who…
Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.
Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to…
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,
A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying…
Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by…
Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
